definitions.explanation: The percentage of a principal amount charged or earned as interest over a given period.

examples.japanese: {利率|りりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
{年|ねん}{利率|りりつ}３⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed at an annual interest rate of 3%.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利率|りりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金融機関|きんゆうきかん}→金融機関：21158_kinyuukikan⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Mortgage interest rates differ depending on the financial institution.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (interest, profit) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio). Used in banking and financial contexts for the percentage of interest on loans, savings, and investments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年|ねん}{利率|りりつ}: annual interest rate
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧{利率|りりつ}: fixed interest rate
- ⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧{利率|りりつ}: variable interest rate
- {利率|りりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: the interest rate rises

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧: interest; interest rate — more commonly used in everyday financial discussions
- ⟦{利子|りし}→利子：17606_rishi⟧: interest (the amount earned or paid) — refers to the actual money, not the rate
- ⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧: interest (on deposits or loans) — similar to ⟦{利子|りし}→利子：17606_rishi⟧, refers to the monetary amount
